items.title: Tim Kelly Interview, 1979-03-26
items.q: You didn't know about Light Crush Pruitt and all that stuff. ... Oh, uh, that was considerably later. Later that you learned about that.

ctx.x: Uh, during my playing years, they didn't exist as far as I knew. Mm-hmm. Speaking of in the 20s. Mm-hmm. Uh, country and Western bands and even hillbilly bands were practically, uh, unknowable. There, there may have been some, but I, I didn't know them. Uh.
You didn't know about Light Crush Pruitt and all that stuff. Uh. Light Crush Doe Boys, I mean. The Light Crush Doe Boys?

Oh, uh, that was considerably later. Later that you learned about that. Let's see, I'm speaking even when radio was very young and, uh, there were no, uh, that I can remember, there were no string bands, really, what we called them.
